findings.value: A street market on Bethnal Green Road, E2, with a mix of goods from clothing to fresh produce. The council calls the area a busy local shopping spot and a place where people meet.

evidence.quote: sells a wide range of items from clothes to fruit and vegetables
Bethnal Green is perhaps better known for its on-going association with boxing, but it is also a major local shopping area and an important social meeting place for the community

notes: One council page only (markets_in_tower_hamlets.aspx, undated). It gives the hours as 'Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm'; that is for the facts researcher. The council page calls the area 'Bethnal Green' rather than the market's own site; the market has no website of its own found. A separate Saturday pop-up on Bethnal Green Road (outside E. Pellicci, 2025) is a different market and was not used. Press search found no review.
